column4: An individual that is unidentifiable to the systems. Note - This should only be applied to truly anonymous users where there is no risk of re-identification
An individual registered to voter with a state or authority.
An individual that is traveling or transiting in the context of location tracking.
An individual employed in a consultative/temporary capacity by the organization.
An individual or other organization that purchases goods or services from the organization.
An individual employed by the organization.
An individual applying for employment to the organization.
A relative of any other individual subject where such a relationship is known.
An individual traveling on some means of provided transport.
An individual identified for the purposes of any medical care.
An individual or organization to whom an organization is selling goods or services.
An individual or organization that holds equity in the organization.
An individual or organization that provides services or goods to the organization.
An individual undergoing training by the organization.
